newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tenders for 80,000 tonnes of white maize.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tenders for 80,000 tonnes of white maize.

text.p: Kenya's National Cereals and Produce Board (NCPB) on Tuesday tendered for the supply of 80,000 tonnes of white maize to arrive at the Mombasa port in three lots. The board must receive all offers by April 29.

The maize should be shipped in two lots of 25,000 tonnes each and one lot of 30,000 tonnes. The first lot should arrive at Mombasa port in mid May and the other two in June -- one lot in either half of that month, the NCPB said in a statement.
